name: Analog tape-to-digital transfer (mail-in)
one_liner: Customers post old VHS/camcorder tapes to you and you send them back as digital files or a flash drive.
customer: Families with old home videos (UK and Portugal households, including the diaspora)
offer: Digitising VHS, MiniDV and Hi8 tapes, delivered by cloud link or USB
how_it_makes_money: $20-30 per tape or about $18.75-25 per hour of footage, with a $25 minimum. 15 tapes a week at $25 comes to about $1,600 a month
startup_cost: low (VCR or camcorder, capture card, PC; no amount stated)
evidence: 'somebody gets paid $20 to $30 a tape' - yrbH5R-j5DI
ARS Video charges $18.75-25 per hour and says it has transferred more than 250,000 hours - yrbH5R-j5DI
'15 tapes a week at $25, that's about $1,600 a month' - yrbH5R-j5DI
risks: Real-time capture takes a lot of hours
Shrinking supply of tapes and working decks
Liability for damaged or lost tapes
Large national services charge around $15 a tape

name: T-shirt / memory quilts (mail-in)
one_liner: Turn a customer's posted T-shirts or clothing into a keepsake quilt.
offer: Custom memory quilt made from the customer's own garments
how_it_makes_money: High-ticket per-piece pricing; one shop charges more than $1,300 per quilt
startup_cost: low-medium (sewing or quilting machine; no amount stated)
evidence: 'One small shop charges more than $1,300 to turn a pile of old T-shirts into a single quilt' - yrbH5R-j5DI
risks: Hard to scale without hiring sewers
Weak evidence: only one price point

name: Furniture flipping
one_liner: Buy cheap solid-wood furniture locally, then refinish and resell it.
customer: Local buyers on Facebook Marketplace, Gumtree, OLX
offer: Painted and refinished dressers and tables
how_it_makes_money: Buy dressers at $40-120 and sell at $325-525; one flipper adds $2.5-3k a month
evidence: Sarah Chen buys dressers at $40-70 and sells at $325-425, adding $2.5-3k a month - 8YO27121ydQ
A teacher turned a $65 table set into $300 - 8YO27121ydQ
risks: Needs physical space and a van
UK resale prices may be lower

name: Party rental: yard signs leading to inflatables
one_liner: Rent celebration lawn letters, then bounce houses, for local parties and events.
offer: Yard-sign greetings (setup and pickup) and bouncy castle hire
how_it_makes_money: Signs about $100 per booking at 8-15 bookings a month; inflatables $150-350 a day, and one operator made about $28k in year one at 28% net margin
startup_cost: low ($500 for signs) to medium (about $12,500 for 3 inflatables)
evidence: Yard greeting $75-125, with part-timers reporting 8-15 bookings a month - pnZLh8zFpss
$12,500 start, about $28k in the first year, about 28% margin - 4x4wvrOyAIk
risks: Weather and seasonality in the UK

name: Managed commercial cleaning (subcontracted)
one_liner: Win office and building cleaning contracts and subcontract the labour.
offer: Recurring janitorial contracts delivered by subcontractor crews
how_it_makes_money: Monthly contracts with a margin over the subcontractor's cost; one owner hit about $25k a month in revenue in about a year alongside a day job
evidence: Luis Garcia: 'probably a $25,000 revenue per month' - 7hgGPvagL0Y
'every single building in America needs' it, run 'without ever showing up' - ejCWJqJ8nKk
risks: Evidence comes from a coaching seller (biased)
Sales relies on calls and walkthroughs

name: Skip/dumpster hire
one_liner: Rent skips weekly to renovators, contractors and people clearing estates.
how_it_makes_money: About $419 a week median; 5 units at 60% use comes to about $5,800 a month gross
evidence: 'Five dumpsters at about $450... roughly $5,800 a month' - O2y83V_ZI2o
risks: Heavy capital and licensing (UK waste carrier licence)
